title.narrative: Entrepreneurship-focused socioemotional skills for the most vulnerable youth in rural Mongolia

description.narrative: The project development objective (PDO) is to train vulnerablecomma disadvantaged youth in 25 of Mongolia’s poorest rural districts across five provinces with socioemotional skills for improved performance in school and preparation for entry into self-employment. The PDO will be achieved through a school-basedcomma community-driven program targeting 6comma000 school-enrolled and out-of-school youth to support acquisition of socioemotional skills that are linked not just to success in schoolcomma but are also highly valued in the labor market. The project will address the largely unmet need for socioemotional and entrepreneurship skills stemming from extremely limited labor market opportunities that lead to high inactivity among youth in these locations and a job profile dominated by traditionalherdingcomma unpaid work and self-employment in the informal sector.
